about: Sova's blast-radius map: changed paths → checks the merge thread adds beyond the required floor. Each rule's `why` is the reason shown on the run. Check ids are checks of .sova/project.json's merge section: optional ones (run only when picked), or required ones that skip themselves (a pick makes them run). A path may hit several rules; a pick is listed once, with every reason joined.

rules.why: statecharts changed: compile them and run their tests
the spec engine or its procedure changed: replay recorded spec sessions
the composer changed: drive its browser tours
the transcript view changed: drive its scrolling tours
the Overseer's schedules menu changed: drive its tour
the flow view changed: drive its focus tour
tours code changed: run the Tours group (a landing never runs it on its own)
chat processes changed: run the Chat processes group (its trigger already does; listed so the reason shows)
the merge queue itself changed: run its own slow group
